newsitem.title: UK: Rolls-Royce extends China aerospace links.
newsitem.headline: Rolls-Royce extends China aerospace links.

text.p: British engineering group Rolls-Royce Plc said on Thursday it signed agreements for further cooperation with BMW Rolls Royce and Aviation Industries of China (AVIC).
Rolls-Royce said the AVIC deal was part of a plan to ensure that manufacturing technology and techniques were transferred to China and developed to the mutual benefit of both companies.
The company also said it agreed to a memorandum of understanding supporting its cooperation with Bayerische Motoren-Werke AG (BMW), in the companies' BMW Rolls-Royce joint venture.
The agreement provides for research projects related to the engineering programme to be carried out with a selection of AVIC research institutes and universities.
